items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Roslyn. And I know he wants to deliver it to you in person. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Is that so?

ctx.x: And Roslyn. And I know he wants to deliver it to you in person. He wrote and told them we were having this big celebration for you. He wrote to a lot of people but that's the first response we got back.
